title: hedyotis schlechtendahliana var. remyi
intro: Hedyotis schlechtendahliana var. remyi, commonly known as Lian Yang Ji or Chinese Hedyotis, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Hedyotis schlechtendahliana var. remyi include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammation, and immunomodulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
